doctrine_compliance_note: Per push-the-envelope doctrine: 'the machine kills its own inventions.' Honest negative results are documented here. The freeze/kill of mechanisms is recorded transparently. Survival to V1 is conditional on V2 verification.

negatives.mechanism: M1 — Patient-specific sizing via pre-procedural imaging
negatives.negative_finding: Patient-specific sizing of vascular implants (TAVR valves, stent grafts, neurovascular catheters) is standard-of-care across interventional radiology/cardiology. eShunt-specific sizing (length, diameter, curvature) is a routine engineering adaptation. No eShunt-specific novelty on sizing alone. 32 Scopus hits + 850 Lens hits on patient-specific shunt sizing literature — extensive prior art.
negatives.implication: M1 dropped at pre-check stage. Does NOT advance to prior-art search.

negatives.negative_finding: Posture-adaptive gravity valves are standard-of-care for VP shunts (Medtronic Strata NSC, Sophysa Polaris SPV, Miethke ProSA). Multiple direct-hit patents: US9731102B2 (DePuy Synthes — gravitational anti-siphon valve), US7922685B2 (Codman — self-adjusting valve), TW201116310A (Neuroentpr — gravity-based CSF drainage), EP2967381B1 + US10864363B2 (Hakim — programmable magnetic valve). 14 Scopus hits on posture+shunt valve literature. eShunt-specific clinical need is REDUCED because eShunt drains to venous sinus (shorter hydrostatic column than head-to-peritoneum, ~30cm vs ~50cm).
negatives.implication: M2 dropped at pre-check stage. Does NOT advance to prior-art search.

negatives.negative_finding: Foundational Hakim patent US4551128A (1960s-70s, original CSF shunt valve). Cordis adjustable-valve family (EP0233325A1, US4781672A, US5336166A, US4557721A, US4776839A) — three-stage implantable pressure relief valve family. US10864363B2 (Hakim — externally programmable magnetic valve). This is the textbook definition of standard-of-care shunt valves (Strata, Polaris, Hakim, ProGAV).
negatives.implication: M3 DESTROYED at pre-check stage. No novelty. Does NOT advance.

negatives.mechanism: M4 — Patient-specific CSF production-rate-matched flow target
negatives.physics_pre_check_verdict: PASSES physics, PARTIAL physiology concern (production rate measurement impractical for routine clinical use)
negatives.negative_finding: Near-direct hits: US8109899B2 (Likvor — fully automated CSF measurement/regulation, likely teaches production-rate-aware drainage), US11173289B2 (CSF Refresh — programmable CSF metering shunt with explicit flow-target), US8869826B2 (Debiotech — passive fluid flow regulator), CA2653898C (Codman — combined pressure+flow sensor in shunt). Production rate measurement requires MRI phase-contrast or invasive ventricular perfusion — not routine clinical use.
negatives.implication: M4 advances to prior-art search but is MARGINAL. Production rate measurement impractical for routine clinical use; combined pressure+flow sensors already patented.

negatives.mechanism: M7 — Patient-specific venous anatomy (custom curved distal tip)
negatives.negative_finding: Custom curved-tip catheters and patient-specific stent geometry are routine engineering adaptation across interventional radiology/cardiology. CereVasc's own catheter patents (US12318564B2, US12485256B2) describe navigating venous anatomy. No eShunt-specific novelty on tip geometry alone.
negatives.implication: M7 dropped at pre-check stage. Does NOT advance.

negatives.mechanism: M8 — Closed-loop non-invasive ICP proxy feedback
negatives.negative_finding: HIGH prior-art density on non-invasive ICP monitoring side: US11357417B2 (Cerebrotech — continuous autoregulation system), US11166671B2 (Cerebrotech — fluid volume differentiation), US10016135B2 (Wolf — transcutaneous ICP monitoring), US8821402B2 (MIT — non-invasive ICP estimation), US9585578B2 (Third Eye — non-invasive ICP measurement), US12171617B2 (Augusta — ICP detection systems). 1525+ Lens hits on ONSD + ICP. Each component (ONSD measurement, non-invasive ICP estimation, programmable shunt adjustment) is individually known; the SYSTEM-LEVEL integration is the only novel angle, but §103 risk is HIGH.
negatives.implication: M8 advances but is parallel candidate (not leading). HIGH §103 risk documented. V2 must passage-audit Cerebrotech patents to confirm absence of closed-loop shunt integration.

negatives.negative_finding: 65+ Lens hits + 57 Scopus hits on ML + hydrocephalus + shunt — mostly OUTCOME PREDICTION models (not adaptive control). Near-direct hit: US8457733B2 (Linninger — impedance-based CSF monitoring/control). KEY RISK: disease trajectory inference from a single pressure/flow sensor may be mathematically NON-IDENTIFIABLE, similar to #1 V22 unidentifiability finding (5 collinear latent states could not be recovered from impedance spectrum under noise). Different diseases (NPH, IIH, post-hem) can produce similar pressure patterns; ML may not reliably distinguish without external data.
negatives.implication: M6 advances but is parallel candidate with CRITICAL identifiability risk. V2 must perform Jacobian/identifiability analysis BEFORE elaborate ML development (per #1 V24/V25 lesson — structural identifiability ≠ numerical identifiability).

summary_honest_disclosure: Of 8 candidate mechanisms brainstormed, 4 were dropped at pre-check stage (M1 WEAK_NOVEL, M2 SATURATED, M3 DESTROYED, M7 WEAK_NOVEL). 4 advanced to prior-art search: M4 (MARGINAL_NOVEL), M5_REFINED (CONDITIONALLY_NOVEL — leading candidate), M6 (CONDITIONALLY_NOVEL + CRITICAL IDENTIFIABILITY RISK), M8 (CONDITIONALLY_NOVEL + HIGH §103 RISK). M5_REFINED survived first attack CONDITIONALLY. The discovery is HONEST: the machine has killed its own inventions (M1, M2, M3, M7) and conditionally spared the others pending V2 verification. No 'LIKELY_NOVEL' language used. Search completeness honestly declared as PARTIAL (PatSnap BLOCKED, Lens patents BLOCKED).
